plan.problem: SSIM batching regressed. Frozen reference images have unchanged local means and variances, yet these require four convolution calls on every revisit.
plan.change: Cache only reference mean and variance per frozen image path and dimensions, capped at 256 MiB logical tensor bytes. Keep prediction statistics, covariance, formula, kernel and gradients unchanged. Bypass for trainable references or capacity misses.
plan.acceptance: Verify cached/miss outputs and gradients, changed predictions, trainable-reference bypass and byte/shape boundaries. Gate full reconstruction comparison on a nonregressing component benchmark; no default engine replacement without full evidence.
plan.microbenchmark_runtime: Use the same runtime options as Brush CLI: tasks_max=64, ExclusivePages. Initial default-runtime component probe is retained separately and not used as the CLI-matched result.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Serial adapter training/evaluation/export, including per-process first reference-statistics cache population. Excludes SfM and input copy; OS and driver caches not flushed. Same instrumented binary in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen shared-camera geometry per scene, every eighth photo excluded from training but used in SfM; all scores recomputed at long edge 512. Two repeats do not establish general gains.
memory_scope: Logical cached reference mean/variance tensor storage only; not allocator capacity or peak process/GPU memory.

microbenchmark.scope: Warm fixed-reference forward, backward and gradient scalar readback; serial ABBA per shape, five warmup iterations and twenty recorded iterations per block. Forty recorded samples per variant. Input construction and pre-run synchronization excluded. CLI-matched tasks_max=64, ExclusivePages. Not total reconstruction or pure hardware GPU time.

preliminary_default_runtime.note: Initial probe used default runtime options rather than the CLI configuration; retained separately and not pooled with the final component data. Different results do not isolate runtime settings as the sole cause.

references.title: Image Quality Assessment: From Error Visibility to Structural Similarity
references.use: Reference local mean and variance depend only on a fixed reference image; only prediction-dependent terms must change each step.

references.title: fused-ssim
references.use: Recent public implementation combines local statistics and supports Metal/MPS. This patch uses existing Burn convolutions and caches fixed reference statistics; no upstream fused kernels are copied.

references.title: Faster-GS (CVPR 2026)
references.use: Motivates matched quality/budget comparisons for implementation changes; CUDA paper speedups are not used as local Metal results.

validation.gpu_reference_test: passed: cold/hit map and prediction gradients, changing predictions, full budget, dimension changes, no key, trainable reference bypass and reference gradients

browser.observations: Models load and drag correctly; thin pipes, wires and text remain blurred, with stretched fragments or holes away from captured views.

decision: Retain the bounded optional reference-statistics cache as a promising performance improvement. Three-scene measured training/evaluation/export means are lower by 5.06%-8.63%, but pipes mean SSIM is lower and only two repeats at 3000/512 were measured. Do not replace the default official engine until default-preset quality/memory validation.
